pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark patches exhibit sub-polygonal geometry with soft-to-medium edge gradients; spatial area varies from larger, elongated rectangles on the neck to smaller, more irregularly rounded shapes on the flank and lower shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned inter-patch pathways are relatively uniform in pixel thickness with clearly defined, frequently occurring tri-junction nodes forming a continuous lattice.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal neck line, presenting as a soft, textured edge against the background sky.
